extensionDescription.message: Provider add-on for TbSync that synchronizes Google Contacts with Thunderbird.

setup.intro.message: To connect a Google account, provide an OAuth client ID and secret you created in the Google Cloud console.

config.readOnlyMode.message: Read-only (do not push local changes to Google)

config.readOnlyBanner.message: To prevent synchronization errors, settings cannot be edited while the account is enabled.
